title: 1. 40 years | Personal lessons ﷺ | Seerat 2026
description:
Welcome to Episode 01 of our Seerat series. In this opening session, we explore why human life is a test of free choice and how Allah sent Prophets as living role models. We look into why the Prophet ﷺ was raised as a "brother" (Akhuhum) from within his own community, someone whose noble character and truthfulness were known to everyone around him.

We delve into his early life to see how personal loss and orphanhood were transformed into active compassion for widows, orphans, and the needy. Through his work as a merchant, we see how he demonstrated total honesty, proving that moral growth is just as important as professional success.

Discover key moments before divine revelation, including how he peacefully resolved the dangerous Black Stone (Hajar-e-Aswad) dispute. We also cover involvement in Hilf al-Fudul, an alliance formed in Mecca to fight oppression and protect the weak, and how deep distress over societal corruption led him to seek solitude in Cave Hira.

Finally, we examine the revolutionary impact of Tawheed. The message of "La ilaha illallah" freed humanity from serving worldly powers and established true equality under divine sovereignty. We close with the steadfast courage and sacrifices of early Muslims, highlighted by the martyrdom of Hazrat Sumayya (RA).
